description: This file contains batch operation functions for managing Drupal translation files, including checking translation status, downloading, importing, and handling remote files, specific to the locale module.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_version_check
methods.description: Checks for project version changes and cleans up old translation data when a module is updated.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_status_check
methods.description: Checks the presence and creation time of translation files on remote server and local system.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_status_finished
methods.description: Sets the result message after batch status check completes.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_fetch_download
methods.description: Downloads remote gettext translation files into the local translations directory.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_fetch_import
methods.description: Imports a gettext translation file from the local directory and updates translation status.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_fetch_finished
methods.description: Sets the last checked timestamp and finalizes the batch process.

methods.name: locale_translation_http_check
methods.description: Checks if a remote translation file exists and retrieves last modified info.

methods.name: locale_translation_download_source
methods.description: Downloads a translation file from a remote server and saves it locally.
